# Security Policy

If you believe you've found an exploitable security issue in Arazzo Toolkit,
**please don't create a public issue**.

## Supported versions

### Arazzo Toolkit
This is the list of versions of Arazzo Toolkit which is
currently being supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          | Notes |
|---------|--------------------|-------|
| ^1.0.0  | :white_check_mark: |       |

## Reporting a vulnerability

To report a vulnerability, please send an email with the details to [info@usearazzo.com](mailto:info@userarazzo.com).

We'll acknowledge receipt of your report ASAP, and set expectations on how we plan to handle it.
